answer_1.quote: We propose Think&Cite, a novel framework integrating search algorithms into attributed text generation.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form answers with in-text citations referencing retrieved passages.

answer_2.quote: We use the evaluation metrics in the original ALCE benchmark. To evaluate the correctness of the output, we use Exact Match (EM) Recall for ASQA, Recall-5 for QAMPARI, and Claim Recall for ELI5... To evaluate the citation quality of the output, we compute Citation Recall and Citation Precision.
